_comment: JARVIS MCP Configuration for Claude Desktop
_instructions: 1. Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your Windows username
2. Replace PROJECT_PATH with actual path to robot_jarvis folder
3. Ensure Python 3.11+ is installed and in PATH
4. Run: pip install mcp pywin32 (pywin32 required on Windows)
6. Look for hammer icon in chat input to verify MCP is active
